title: Proposal for Guidelines to be Given to Third Party Food Delivery Companies to Charge F&B Businesses Smaller Commissions
what_it_is: Proposal for Guidelines to be Given to Third Party Food Delivery Companies to Charge F&B Businesses Smaller Commissions

sections.label: Restaurant delivery commission guidelines
sections.summary: A question asks whether guidelines or legislation can let restaurants pay smaller commissions to third party food delivery companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry whether guidelines or legislation can be considered to enable restaurants to pay smaller commissions and foster a more equitable partnership with third party food delivery companies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: However, we need to carefully consider whether legislation is the appropriate solution in this situation.

sections.label: Food Delivery Booster Package
sections.summary: The Food Delivery Booster Package by ESG funds five percentage points of the commission charged by Deliveroo, foodpanda and GrabFood.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: One example is the Food Delivery Booster Package by ESG to fund five percentage points of the commission charged by Deliveroo, foodpanda and GrabFood.

sections.label: Booster Package extension and commissions
sections.summary: The Booster Package has benefited over 9,000 food services businesses and ESG will continue it till 1 June 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Booster Package has benefited more than 9,000 food services businesses so far.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In view of the extended Circuit Breaker period, ESG will continue to provide this Package till 1 June 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, I would like to bring back the point on the 30% to 35% commission charged by GrabFood, Deliveroo and foodpanda in the market.

sections.label: Temporary commission cap consideration
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Government will consider temporary measures to limit delivery platform commissions during the COVID-19 pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: When banks charge commission, we compel the banks to share with the customers; it would be similar thinking along that line.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: I would also like to ask Senior Parliamentary Secretary whether the Government will consider temporary measures to limit commissions charged by delivery platforms – maybe just temporary – during this COVID-19 pandemic, where restaurants dine-in operations are not allowed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: A number of cities in the US, including San Francisco and Seattle, have already passed Emergency Orders temporarily capping delivery app commissions at 15%.

sections.label: Self-delivery versus legislation
sections.summary: The approach can include businesses doing delivery to customers on their own, which is better than legislation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: It can also include them doing the delivery to customers on their own.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I think this is the approach that will produce a better outcome compared to using legislation, which is a rather blunt instrument.
